### MV IN RANGE
Returns `true` if at least one value of `field` is within the inclusive range `[lower, upper]`. Null or empty fields return `false`.

```esql
ROW values = [1, 5, 10]
| EVAL in_range = mv_in_range(values, 4, 6)
```
